name: @local/dsh-oks
description: A Harness capability, not a wrapper for one model: whatever knowledge service (OKS) and data file a session's workspace declares in oks.json become three native tools — info / check_intent / query — turning a business question into rows read from that data file over a read-only connection. The knowledge catalog is explored through oks_info, starting from the opaque key "index".
